summary: Sync to the private genki-data repo: a device-only GitHub token in a separate IndexedDB database, Sync now plus once-a-day auto-sync of app/latest.json with sha-conflict retry, restore with a confirm, and a CSP meta limiting scripts to self and connections to api.github.com.
why: Phase 5 part 2 of the genki plan: off-device copy of the data without a backend.
